label: Rayong
short_description: Loyalty-program beach resort in Rayong, the quieter Eastern Seaboard coast beyond Pattaya.
intro: Rayong's coverage in this directory is a beach resort on Thailand's Eastern Seaboard, southeast of Pattaya along the Gulf coast toward Ban Phe and the Ko Samet ferry. Quieter and more nature-oriented than Pattaya, the area suits a relaxed beach stay and is reached via U-Tapao (UTP) airport or the motorway from Bangkok.
